title: Spanish Review, Week of November 19: Weather, a Wedding Trip, and Lo, La, Los, Las
intro: Welcome to your Spanish review for the week of November nineteenth. First, this week's new words. You'll hear the English, then a pause. Say the Spanish out loud, then listen to it twice. After that, a verb drill, a review of older words, and a conversation that uses what you've learned. Let's start.

sections.name: Describing things.
items: heavy. Also said of a big file.
busy. For a man, then for a woman.

sections.name: Travel, and a wedding.
items: map. It's masculine, even though it ends in A.

sections.name: Work and tech.
items: la organización sin fines de lucro

sections.name: Grammar. Saying it, and them. The little word matches the thing, and it goes before the verb.

drills.name: Verb drill. Enviar, to send. Present tense.
Llover, to rain.
items: that it rains. The form used after que.

recap.name: Now a review of older words. Weather, travel, and a few from earlier weeks.
items: good weather. Bueno gets shorter here.

conversation.intro: Now, a conversation. Sofía and Diego are talking on the phone before a wedding. First you'll hear it slowly, with English after each line.
lines: A
Hola, Diego. ¿Cómo está el clima allá?
Hi, Diego. How's the weather over there?
B
Está muy raro. Ayer llovió, y hoy hace mucho calor.
It's very strange. Yesterday it rained, and today it's very hot.
A
No es común en el otoño.
That's not common in the fall.
B
No, es fuera de lo común. ¿Y allá?
No, it's out of the ordinary. And there?
A
Aquí está nevando, y hay mucho viento.
Here it's snowing, and it's very windy.
B
Oye, ¿vas a ir a la boda de mi hermano?
Hey, are you going to go to my brother's wedding?
A
¡Claro! ¿Tú eres el padrino de bodas?
Of course! Are you the best man?
B
Sí. Estoy muy ocupado esta semana.
Yes. I'm very busy this week.
A
¿Ya compraste los boletos?
Did you buy the tickets yet?
B
Sí, los compré ayer. Son de ida y vuelta.
Yes, I bought them yesterday. They're round trip.
A
¿Y la habitación del hotel?
And the hotel room?
B
La reservé también. No es barata, pero voy a ahorrar dinero en la comida.
I booked it too. It's not cheap, but I'm going to save money on food.
A
¿Tienes el mapa de la ciudad?
Do you have the map of the city?
B
No, no lo tengo. ¿Puedes enviar el archivo?
No, I don't have it. Can you send the file?
A
Sí, pero es muy pesado, y mi computadora es lenta.
Yes, but it's very big, and my computer is slow.
B
No importa. Yo espero.
It doesn't matter. I'll wait.
A
¿Y quién va a cuidar a Papa?
And who's going to take care of Papa?
B
Mi mamá. Ella lo quiere mucho.
My mom. She loves him a lot.
A
¿Tu mamá no tiene un gato?
Doesn't your mom have a cat?
B
Sí, tiene un gato y un gatito. Papa los mira todo el día.
Yes, she has a cat and a kitten. Papa watches them all day.
A
¿Y tus llaves? Siempre las pierdes.
And your keys? You always lose them.
B
Las tengo en mi mochila. Tengo todas mis cosas aquí.
I have them in my backpack. I have all my things here.
A
Muy bien. Nos vemos en la boda. ¿Tienes los boletos?
Very good. See you at the wedding. Do you have the tickets?
B
Sí, sí, los tengo. Un momento. ¿Dónde están los boletos?
Yes, yes, I have them. One moment. Where are the tickets?

outro: That's it for this week. Nice work. Hasta la próxima.
